import bpy, os
from mathutils import Vector
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
actual=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))
if actual!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
print('FILE='+bpy.data.filepath)
print('--- TERRAIN OBJECTS ---')
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    n=o.name.lower()
    if 'terreno' in n or 'terrain' in n:
        if o.type=='MESH' and len(o.bound_box):
            pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
            xs=[p.x for p in pts]; ys=[p.y for p in pts]; zs=[p.z for p in pts]
            print(f'{o.name}|coll={[c.name for c in o.users_collection]}|X={min(xs):.2f}..{max(xs):.2f}|Y={min(ys):.2f}..{max(ys):.2f}|Z={min(zs):.2f}..{max(zs):.2f}|hide={o.hide_viewport}')
print('--- TERRAIN COLLECTIONS ---')
for c in bpy.data.collections:
    if 'terreno' in c.name.lower() or 'terrain' in c.name.lower(): print(c.name, 'hideV',c.hide_viewport,'hideR',c.hide_render,'objects',len(c.objects))
pts=[]
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.type!='MESH' or 'terreno' in o.name.lower() or 'terrain' in o.name.lower(): continue
    if o.hide_viewport: continue
    try: pts += [o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    except: pass
if pts:
    xs=[p.x for p in pts];ys=[p.y for p in pts];zs=[p.z for p in pts]
    print(f'VISIBLE_URBAN_BOUNDS X={min(xs):.2f}..{max(xs):.2f} Y={min(ys):.2f}..{max(ys):.2f} Z={min(zs):.2f}..{max(zs):.2f}')
print('AUDIT_WORLD_TERRAIN_OK')
